text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's challenge made a massive 
impact. Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka are 
training with fierce determination to 
secure victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Aston Machan hadn't been 
feeling well ever since spring arrived. 
Medical exams revealed no clear cause. She 
claimed it was because she wasn't "good 
friends with spring," but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, she begins claiming she can 
hear the sound of waves. Can she recover 
from this mysterious slump before the Oka 
Sho?
